summary: Local public registry preparation composes public Atlas seed synchronization, registry projections and exact twelve-target organization retirement, then the maintained raw Kit source lock, both skill manifests, own registry rows and affected-output recheck. The lock stage uses the existing repos.sh roster selector and relock generator with an isolated exact roster; it bounds skill/file sources to managed public roots and refuses traversal, absolute paths, symlinks, unsupported or nonregular inputs before digest generation. Raw SKILL.md/file hashing remains distinct from canonical skill-body hashing. Stale or unavailable upstream inputs block dependent mutation; check mode reports every family without writing and unchanged preparation is idempotent. Retirement refuses malformed, extra raw, inline, padded, duplicate, partial, reversed or overlapping markers before changing any retired target. Product and shared Protocol facts retain their semantics; default full generation/check still requires genuine current engine emission against committed outputs. Independent caller controls require 27 active projection regions, ten paired skill-reference regions per root, all twelve named organization regions absent and retained product regions present. Organization reporting consumes owning/native evidence without a mandatory reporting workload, while qualified product reporter utility controls remain unchanged. The first PR4652 native cohort failed four jobs in three connected families: two stale Kit lock rows, obsolete projection counts and coupled organization/product reporting prose. Those failures and the earlier source-only closure miss remain failures; the connected source repair includes downstream callers and raw lock closure. No Kit membership, foreign producer rows, materialization predicates, publication, installed adoption or live consumer activation changes. Inert tests and source review establish no full Protocol/CLR/package qualification, native acceptance or measured savings; fresh required hosted CI remains mandatory.
title: Prepare every local consumer projection, raw Kit lock and skill digest
